description: This file defines the 'User' class in the OpenMRS system, representing a user account with properties like username, email, roles, and associated person details. It includes methods for role and privilege management, user properties, and basic account metadata.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user account in the OpenMRS system, with properties for username, email, roles, person info, user preferences, and account metadata, along with methods for role/privilege checks and property management.

methods.name: isSuperUser
methods.description: Checks if the user has the 'superuser' role.

methods.name: hasPrivilege
methods.description: Determines if the user possesses a specific privilege, including superuser privileges.

methods.name: hasRole
methods.description: Verifies if the user has a specific role by name, considering superuser status.

methods.name: containsRole
methods.description: Checks if the user has a role matching the provided role name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getPrivileges
methods.description: Aggregates all privileges granted to the user through roles.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Returns all roles associated with the user, including inherited parent roles.

methods.name: addRole
methods.description: Adds a role to the user.

methods.name: removeRole
methods.description: Removes a role from the user.

methods.name: getProficientLocales
methods.description: Returns the list of locales for which the user is proficient, parsed from user properties.

methods.name: hydrate
methods.description: Loads a User object based on user ID string, used for retrieval.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the user for persistence or transport.

methods.name: getDisplayString
methods.description: Provides a display string combining person's full name and username.
